verdict.rationale: Bento documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp. Users point their AI app at the URL and add API keys, with nothing to install, and the agent can look up subscribers, create broadcasts and track events. Bento Skills adds agent-facing guidance on when to use MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and an exhaustive documented tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Bento MCP server gives your AI assistant direct access to your Bento account. It can look up subscribers, create broadcasts, track events, and more, all through natural conversation.
Bento hosts the MCP server at `https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp`. You point your AI app at that URL and add your API keys. There's nothing to install, run, or update.
Bento Skills tells the agent when to use Bento MCP, the CLI, an SDK, or n8n.
